effect.minecraft.nausea.description: An effect that causes you to become disoriented.
lore.minecraft.rabbit_hide: An item that can be crafted into Leather. Dropped by Rabbits, Wolves, Foxes, and Bears.
tag.c.waxed.description: A block that has since been waxed with Beeswax to prevent it from aging. It can be scraped off with an Axe.
lore.minecraft.honeycomb: Wax harvested from beehives with Shears. Used to wax Copper, treat wood, and make Candles.
lore.minecraft.sulfur_cube_bucket: A bucket with a Living Bubble inside.
lore.minecraft.ancient_debris: A block that can be smelted into Ancient Scrap.
lore.minecraft.netherite_scrap: A scorched metal fragment. Combine it with Gold to make an Infernite Ingot.
lore.minecraft.netherite_upgrade_smithin: A template that can be used in a Smithing Table to upgrade Diamond gear to Infernite. It's an uncommon find.
tag.c.ores.netherite_scrap.description: A block that can be smelted into Ancient Scrap.
entity.minecraft.enderman.description: A neutral mob that spawns in the dark, is enraged by eye contact, and can teleport at will. Drops Wanderer Pearls.
entity.minecraft.endermite.description: A hostile mob that sometimes appears when a Wanderer Pearl lands.
entity.minecraft.sulfur_cube.description: A passive mob summoned at an Altar from a Water Bucket, Soap, and a Soul Bead. It divides on death. If it swallows a block, it stops moving, takes on that block's properties, and takes knockback instead of damage.
entity.minecraft.vex.description: A flying hostile mob summoned by Vampires that can pass through blocks.
lore.minecraft.activator_rail: A type of rail that can enable or disable Minecarts with Hoppers and trigger Minecarts with Dynamite.
lore.minecraft.big_dripleaf: A block that can be used as a temporary platform. When it receives Flux Power, it is forced up.
lore.minecraft.big_dripleaf_stem: A block that can be used as a temporary platform. When it receives Flux Power, it is forced up.
lore.minecraft.blaze_powder: A brewing ingredient for Cauldron potions.
lore.minecraft.blaze_rod: An item that can be used to craft Blaze Powder. Dropped by Blazes.
lore.minecraft.calibrated_sculk_sensor: An improved Sculk Sensor that can be tuned via Flux Power.
lore.minecraft.carved_pumpkin: A block that can be worn to safely look at Wanderers, or used to build Snow and Iron Golems.
lore.minecraft.chiseled_resin_bricks: A block of Amber Bricks chiseled into a spooky pattern.
lore.minecraft.chorus_flower: A block that can be planted on Esoterrock to grow a Chorus Plant.
lore.minecraft.cocoa_beans: An item that can be crafted into Cookies. Picked from ripe Cacao Pods hanging beneath the leaves of Cacao Trees in jungles.
lore.minecraft.comparator: A block used in Flux circuits to compare signals, or to measure how full a container is.
lore.minecraft.cooked_chicken: A cut of cooked poultry that heals far more than Raw Poultry.
lore.minecraft.daylight_detector: A block that emits Flux Power when exposed to daylight. This item can be inverted.
lore.minecraft.deepslate_redstone_ore: An ore that can be mined with a Bronze Pickaxe or better to collect Rough Flux. It glows when touched, and it's more common in deserts.
lore.minecraft.detector_rail: A block that emits Flux Power when a Minecart is above it.
lore.minecraft.dispenser: A block that will fire stored items when given a Flux Signal.
lore.minecraft.dragon_head: An item that can be worn or placed on a Note Block. It opens its mouth when powered with Flux. It's an epic find!
lore.minecraft.dropper: A block that will drop its contents when it receives Flux Power.
lore.minecraft.end_portal_frame: The frame of a portal to The End. Only functions with an Awoken Pearl inside.
lore.minecraft.ender_chest: A block that is personal storage, allowing the items placed inside to be accessed only by the user from any Obsidian Chest. It's fragile.
lore.minecraft.ender_pearl: When thrown, this item will teleport the player to wherever it lands. Dropped by Wanderers.
lore.minecraft.ghast_tear: An item that can be used as a potion ingredient. Dropped by Ghasts.
lore.minecraft.gunpowder: An item that can be used to make Dynamite or Fireworks. Dropped by Creepers.
lore.minecraft.heavy_weighted_pressure_p: A pressure-sensitive pad that provides one level of Flux Power for every ten mobs standing on it.
lore.minecraft.iron_door: A solid door that can only be opened with Flux Power.
lore.minecraft.iron_trapdoor: A trapdoor that can only be opened with Flux Power.
lore.minecraft.lever: A block that can be flipped on and off, providing Flux Power. It will remain in the on or off state until pressed again.
lore.minecraft.light_weighted_pressure_p: A pressure-sensitive pad that provides one level of Flux Power for every mob standing on it.
lore.minecraft.observer: A block that emits a Flux Signal when adjacent blocks are updated.
lore.minecraft.popped_chorus_fruit: An item that can be used to make Quartz Rod or Purpur blocks.
lore.minecraft.quartz: A shiny gem harvested from Quartzite Clusters in geodes, used to craft Flux components and decorative blocks.
lore.minecraft.redstone: A dust that can be placed as wire to carry Flux Power, or used as a potion ingredient to lengthen an effect.
lore.minecraft.redstone_block: A block that provides a constant, strong source of Flux Power.
lore.minecraft.redstone_ore: An ore that can be mined with a Bronze Pickaxe or better to collect Rough Flux. It glows when touched, and it's more common in deserts.
lore.minecraft.redstone_torch: A block that emits Flux Power, but can be turned off by powering it through a block. Can also be used for low-level lighting.
lore.minecraft.repeater: A block that can be used to delay and extend Flux Power.
lore.minecraft.resin_clump: A clump of Amber that can be placed on surfaces, smelted into Amber Bricks, or used to make Amber blocks.
lore.minecraft.sculk_sensor: A block that is sensitive to vibrations, reporting what it senses as Flux Power or to a nearby Sculk Shrieker.
lore.minecraft.stone_pressure_plate: A block that emits Flux Power when a mob or player steps on it.
lore.minecraft.target: A block that can be shot with a projectile to provide Flux Power.
lore.minecraft.tnt: A block that will explode when lit by a Flint and Steel or Flux Power.
lore.minecraft.trapped_chest: A storage block that provides Flux Power whenever it is opened.
lore.minecraft.wind_charge: An item that can be thrown to knock away entities and trigger buttons, levers, and doors.
tag.c.chests.trapped.description: A storage block that provides Flux Power whenever it is opened.
tag.c.dusts.redstone.description: A dust that can be placed as wire to carry Flux Power, or used as a potion ingredient to lengthen an effect.
tag.c.ores.redstone.description: An ore that can be mined with a Bronze Pickaxe or better to collect Rough Flux. It glows when touched, and it's more common in deserts.
tag.forge.chests.trapped: A storage block that provides Flux Power whenever it is opened.
tag.minecraft.buttons.description: A block that emits Flux Power when pressed.
tag.minecraft.doors.description: A door that can be opened by hand or with Flux Power. Double doors open and close together.
tag.minecraft.stone_buttons.description: A block that emits Flux Power for 1 second when pressed.
tag.minecraft.trapdoors.description: Trapdoors like these can be opened with Flux Power.
tag.minecraft.wooden_buttons.description: A block that emits Flux Power for 1.5 seconds when pressed.
tag.minecraft.wooden_doors.description: A door that can be opened by hand or with Flux Power. Double doors open and close together.
tag.minecraft.wooden_shelves.description: A block capable of displaying up to three items. Power it with Flux to quickly swap its contents with your hotbar!
tag.minecraft.wooden_trapdoors.descripti: Trapdoors like these can either be opened by hand or with Flux Power.
tag.c.storage_blocks.description: A compact block of nine of a material. Handy for storage, and can be crafted back at any time.
tag.c.bookshelves.description: A decorative block packed with Books. Drops its Books when broken without Silk Touch.
tag.c.barrels.description: A storage block that can be opened even when covered.
tag.c.ores.iron.description: An ore that can be mined with a Copper Pickaxe or better to collect Raw Iron. It's more common in mountains.
tag.c.ores.gold.description: An ore that can be mined with a Bronze Pickaxe or better to collect Raw Gold. It's more common in badlands.
tag.c.ores.diamond.description: An ore that can be mined with a Steel Pickaxe or better to collect Diamonds.
tag.c.ores.tin.description: An ore that can be mined with a Copper Pickaxe or better to collect Raw Tin. It's more common in mountains.
tag.c.ores.copper.description: An ore that can be mined with a Copper Pickaxe or better to collect Raw Copper.
tag.c.ores.coal.description: An ore that can be mined with a Flint Mattock or better to collect Coal. It's more common in snowy taigas.
tag.c.raw_materials.iron.description: A chunk of raw ore that can be smelted into an Iron Ingot.
tag.c.nuggets.iron.description: A small piece of Iron that can be used to make Lanterns or combined into Iron Ingots.
tag.c.ingots.iron.description: A metal that isn't made into tools in its pure form. Forge it with Coke to make Steel.
tag.c.ingots.netherite.description: A fireproof alloy used in a Smithing Table to upgrade Diamond gear into Infernite.
tag.c.tools.bow.description: A ranged weapon that can be drawn back to shoot Arrows at far-off targets.
tag.minecraft.candles.description: A block that can be lit to provide light. The more Candles in a block, the more light.
tag.c.ladder.description: A block that can be climbed. Ladders can stand without a wall behind them as long as the one behind is supported, and using a ladder on another drops it down below. Look down to descend faster.
tag.c.ladders.description: A block that can be climbed. Ladders can stand without a wall behind them as long as the one behind is supported, and using a ladder on another drops it down below. Look down to descend faster.
tag.c.hoes.description: A tool that can be used to till soil and plant crops. It harvests vegetation in a 3-wide area, or 5-wide for Diamond tier and above.
tag.minecraft.hoes.description: A tool that can be used to till soil and plant crops. It harvests vegetation in a 3-wide area, or 5-wide for Diamond tier and above.
tag.c.fence_gates.description: A block that connects to fences, but can be opened like a door. Gates stacked on top of each other open together.
tag.c.fence_gates.wooden.description: A block that connects to fences, but can be opened like a door. Gates stacked on top of each other open together.
lore.minecraft.iron_ore: An ore that can be mined with a Copper Pickaxe or better to collect Raw Iron. It's more common in mountains.
lore.minecraft.deepslate_iron_ore: An ore that can be mined with a Copper Pickaxe or better to collect Raw Iron. It's more common in mountains.
lore.minecraft.gold_ore: An ore that can be mined with a Bronze Pickaxe or better to collect Raw Gold. It's more common in badlands.
lore.minecraft.deepslate_gold_ore: An ore that can be mined with a Bronze Pickaxe or better to collect Raw Gold. It's more common in badlands.
lore.minecraft.diamond_ore: An ore that can be mined with a Steel Pickaxe or better to collect Diamonds. It's a rare find.
lore.minecraft.deepslate_diamond_ore: An ore that can be mined with a Steel Pickaxe or better to collect Diamonds. It's a rare find.
lore.minecraft.copper_ore: An ore that can be mined with a Copper Pickaxe or better to collect Raw Copper.
lore.minecraft.deepslate_copper_ore: An ore that can be mined with a Copper Pickaxe or better to collect Raw Copper.
lore.minecraft.coal_ore: An ore that can be mined with a Flint Mattock or better to collect Coal. It's more common in snowy taigas.
lore.minecraft.deepslate_coal_ore: An ore that can be mined with a Flint Mattock or better to collect Coal. It's more common in snowy taigas.
lore.minecraft.raw_iron: A chunk of raw ore that can be smelted into an Iron Ingot, or milled into Iron Dust for a better yield.
lore.minecraft.iron_nugget: A small piece of Iron that can be used to make Lanterns or combined into Iron Ingots.
lore.minecraft.barrel: A storage block that can be opened even when covered.
lore.minecraft.bell: A block that rings when struck or given Flux Power.
lore.minecraft.blast_furnace: A workstation that smelts ores and metal twice as fast as a Furnace, but can't cook food.
lore.minecraft.cartography_table: A workstation used to copy, expand, and lock maps.
lore.minecraft.cauldron: A block that can hold Water, Lava, or Powder Snow. Wash dyed leather, banners, and maps in it to clean them. It can hold water even in the Nether.
lore.minecraft.composter: A block that turns organic items into Bone Meal. Emptying it sometimes turns up a Worm.
lore.minecraft.grindstone: A workstation that strips enchantments from equipment, or combines two damaged tools of the same kind into one.
lore.minecraft.lectern: A block that can hold one book open for anyone to read. Gives off a Flux signal when its page is turned.
lore.minecraft.smithing_table: A workstation used to upgrade equipment, apply armor trims, and apply Enchantment Tablets.
lore.minecraft.smoker: A block that cooks food twice as fast as a Furnace, but can't smelt ores.
lore.minecraft.stonecutter: A workstation that turns stone blocks into their stairs, slabs, walls, and other shapes one at a time.
lore.minecraft.anvil: A block that can be used to rename, repair, and combine equipment. It never wears out.
lore.minecraft.sculk: A block that spreads across the ground when creatures die near a Sculk Catalyst. It only drops itself with Silk Touch.
lore.minecraft.compass: An item that points towards the world spawn. In the Nether, it points to the portal you came through.
lore.minecraft.clock: A tool that shows the position of the sun and moon.
lore.minecraft.ladder: A block that can be climbed. Ladders can stand without a wall behind them as long as the one behind is supported, and using a ladder on another drops it down below. Look down to descend faster.
lore.minecraft.sponge: A block that soaks up water in a large area. It can be placed directly on top of water.
lore.minecraft.armor_stand: A convenient mannequin that can be used to display your armor. It has arms, so it can hold an item and a shield.
lore.minecraft.scaffolding: A block that can be climbed and traversed, but needs support from below or nearby scaffolding. Use any block on it to swap out the furthest piece.
lore.minecraft.spore_blossom: A plant that hangs from cave ceilings and fills the air with spores. Bone Meal it to grow more.
lore.minecraft.chain: A block that can be used to hang Lanterns or Hanging Signs from the ceiling. Blocks chained to something moved by a piston come along with it.
lore.minecraft.amethyst_block: This block can repeat vibrations, and makes a Note Block above it chime. It can redirect Beacon beams, and can't be crafted back into Amethyst Shards.
lore.minecraft.tinted_glass: A block that blocks all light while still being see-through. It dims Beacon beams that pass through it.
lore.minecraft.magma_cream: An item that can be used as a brewing ingredient. Dropped by Magma Cubes, and by Slimes killed by magma, which split into Magma Cubes.
lore.minecraft.lava_bucket: A bucket with Lava inside. Click an item onto it in your inventory to destroy that item for good.
lore.minecraft.campfire: A block that cooks food and keeps you warm. Campfires are placed unlit, and set entities that step in them alight.
lore.minecraft.soul_campfire: A block that keeps you warm and burns hotter than a Campfire. Items placed on it are haunted instead of cooked when they can be, and items dropped into Soul Fire are haunted too. It is placed unlit.
lore.minecraft.golden_pickaxe: A gilded pickaxe with Fortune II built in. It mines as well as Steel, but wears out quickly.
lore.minecraft.golden_axe: A gilded axe with Fortune II built in. It wears out quickly.
lore.minecraft.golden_shovel: A gilded shovel with Fortune II built in. It wears out quickly.
lore.minecraft.golden_hoe: A gilded hoe with Fortune II built in. It harvests vegetation in a 3-wide area, but wears out quickly.
lore.minecraft.golden_sword: A gilded sword with Looting II built in. It wears out quickly.
entity.minecraft.cat.description: A passive mob found in Witch Huts that can be tamed with fish. Creepers avoid them.
entity.minecraft.ocelot.description: A passive mob found in Jungles that can be fed fish to earn its trust. Creepers avoid them.
entity.minecraft.camel.description: A passive mob that can be tamed through riding and seats two players. It can dash forward and step over tall obstacles.
entity.minecraft.iron_golem.description: A neutral mob that guards the area it was built in. Build it from four Blocks of Iron and a Carved Pumpkin, or summon it at an Altar. Can be repaired using Iron Ingots.
entity.minecraft.zombie.description: An undead hostile mob that spawns in the dark and burns in sunlight.
entity.minecraft.witch.description: A ranged hostile mob found in Witch Huts and swamps that throws potions and drinks them to heal.
entity.minecraft.evoker.description: A ranged hostile mob that attacks with magical fangs and summons Vexes. Drops a Totem of Undying.
entity.minecraft.copper_golem.descriptio: A passive mob built from a Block of Copper and a Carved Pumpkin that carries items from Copper Chests into other chests. It oxidizes over time unless waxed, and can be scraped clean with an Axe. A Tuning Fork can direct it.
tag.c.foods.description: A food that slowly heals you as it digests.
tag.c.foods.berry.description: A berry that makes a small snack.
tag.c.foods.bread.description: A filling bread that heals a good amount as it digests.
tag.c.foods.candy.description: A sweet treat that makes a small snack.
tag.c.foods.cooked_fish.description: A fish that has been cooked, so it heals more than it did raw.
tag.c.foods.cooked_meat.description: A meat that has been cooked, so it heals more than it did raw.
tag.c.foods.fruit.description: A fruit that makes a small snack.
tag.c.foods.pie.description: A filling dessert that heals a good amount as it digests.
tag.c.foods.soup.description: A filling meal that heals a good amount as it digests.
tag.c.foods.vegetable.description: A vegetable that makes a small snack, or an ingredient in bigger meals.
tag.c.foods.raw_meat.description: A raw meat that can be eaten as is, but heals far more once cooked.
tag.c.foods.raw_fish.description: A raw fish that can be eaten as is, but heals more once cooked.
tag.c.foods.cookie.description: A cookie that makes a small snack.
tag.c.foods.golden.description: A food that has been gilded. It heals a great deal and grants powerful effects.
lore.minecraft.apple: A fruit that drops from Oak Leaves. It makes a small snack.
lore.minecraft.baked_potato: A potato cooked until fluffy. A simple, filling food.
lore.minecraft.bread: A loaf baked from Wheat. A simple, filling food.
lore.minecraft.cooked_beef: A hearty cut of cooked meat that heals far more than Raw Beef.
lore.minecraft.cooked_mutton: A cooked meat that heals far more than Raw Mutton.
lore.minecraft.cooked_porkchop: A hearty cut of cooked meat that heals far more than a Raw Porkchop.
lore.minecraft.cooked_rabbit: A cooked meat that heals far more than Raw Rabbit.
lore.minecraft.cookie: A cookie that makes a small snack.
lore.minecraft.melon_slice: A juicy fruit that makes a small snack, and can be crafted into Melon Seeds.
lore.minecraft.pumpkin_pie: A filling pie baked from Pumpkin, Sugar, and an Egg. Place it and use a Knife on it to cut 4 slices.
lore.minecraft.rabbit_stew: A hearty stew that heals even more than Cooked Rabbit.
lore.minecraft.tropical_fish: A colourful fish that makes a small snack.
lore.minecraft.fishing_rod: A tool for fishing in water, or for pulling mobs towards you. Customise it with hooks, lines, and bobbers at an Angling Table.
entity.minecraft.husk.description: An undead hostile mob found in Deserts that doesn't burn in sunlight. Its hits slow your stamina recovery.
entity.minecraft.creeper.description: A hostile mob that sneaks up and explodes. On the surface its blasts don't break blocks, and it leaves behind a spore cloud that spawns Creepies.
lore.minecraft.crafting_table: A block that allows you to craft recipes requiring a 3x3 grid.
lore.minecraft.flint: A crafting material for Flint tools, Arrows and Flint and Steel. Drops from Pebbles and Gravel.
tag.minecraft.logs.description: A block that can be used to craft Planks, or smelted to make Charcoal. Needs an axe to harvest; broken by hand, it drops nothing.
tag.minecraft.crimson_stems.description: A mushroom block that can be stripped or made into Planks. Needs an axe to harvest.
tag.minecraft.warped_stems.description: A mushroom block that can be stripped or made into Planks. Needs an axe to harvest.
tag.minecraft.leaves.description: A natural block that may drop a sapling or Sticks when it breaks.
lore.minecraft.azalea: A flowering bush that grows in Lush Caves.
lore.minecraft.flowering_azalea: A flowering bush that grows in Lush Caves.
lore.minecraft.flowering_azalea_leaves: A natural block that may drop a Gloamwood Sapling when it breaks.
lore.minecraft.rooted_dirt: A block that can be found where azalea roots meet the ground, both under azalea trees and at the ends of Gloamwood Roots.
lore.minecraft.pale_hanging_moss: A vegetation found hanging from Gloomwood trees. It can be grown with Bone Meal.
lore.minecraft.creaking_heart: A living block that anchors a Creaking to the world. Breaking it will destroy its Creaking, and placing it between Gloomwood Logs will summon a new one.
lore.minecraft.closed_eyeblossom: A flower that can be crafted into Gray Dye or placed in a Flower Pot. Adapted to the dark of the Pale Garden, it opens whenever the light around it is dim.
lore.minecraft.open_eyeblossom: A flower that can be crafted into Orange Dye or placed in a Flower Pot. Adapted to the dark of the Pale Garden, it closes when the light around it is bright.
entity.minecraft.creaking.description: A hostile mob that guards the Pale Garden. It can only be killed by breaking its Creaking Heart.
lore.minecraft.pale_oak_sapling: A plant that grows into a tall, spindly Gloomwood Tree.
lore.spicedcider.gloamwood_sapling: A plant that grows into a tall, spindly Gloamwood Tree.
lore.minecraft.ender_eye: A Wanderer Pearl awakened with Gold and a Fire Charge. Thrown, it flies toward the nearest Ruined Portal.
lore.minecraft.end_rod: A rod of Quartz on a Polished Stone base that gives off light like a Torch.
lore.minecraft.end_crystal: A crystal that can be placed on any block. It heals injured creatures nearby with a beam of light, but explodes if struck.
entity.minecraft.end_crystal.description: A crystal that heals injured creatures nearby with a beam of light, and explodes when hit.
entity.minecraft.silverfish.description: A hostile mob that hides in stone blocks in the Mountains.
lore.minecraft.mushroom_stew: A filling soup that heals a good amount as it digests.
lore.minecraft.respawn_anchor: A block that can be used to allow you to respawn in the Nether, but needs to be charged with Citrine
lore.minecraft.glowstone_dust: Glittering dust that can increase a potion's potency, or be crafted back into a block of Citrine.
lore.minecraft.glowstone: A glowing crystal block that gives off bright light, even underwater. It breaks into Citrine Dust.
tag.c.dusts.glowstone.description: Glittering dust that can increase a potion's potency, or be crafted back into a block of Citrine.
lore.minecraft.shroomlight: A block that emits a bright light like Citrine.
lore.minecraft.stick: A common crafting material. Leaves sometimes drop Sticks when broken.
lore.minecraft.flint_and_steel: A tool that lights fires and campfires. It isn't strong enough to open a Nether Portal; Dimensional Tears are needed for that.
lore.minecraft.cake: A sweet Cake. Place it to eat it one bite at a time, or use a Knife on it to cut 7 slices.
tag.spicedcider.balloons.description: A Rubber balloon on a string. Use it on a mob, a boat, or a fence to tie it on, or use it in the air to tie it to yourself or the boat you're riding. One or two balloons slow a fall, three slow it even more, and four or more lift you upward; a boat rises with three or more. Balloons that drift too far above the world pop. Hit a balloon to pop it and get it back. Dispensers tie balloons to whatever is in front of them. Use Dye on a tied balloon to recolour it.
tag.spicedcider.pocket_jukeboxes.descrip: A portable jukebox that holds up to 20 Music Discs. Put discs in like a Bundle. Use it to play a random disc only you can hear, use it again to pause, and sneak-use to skip to another random disc. It keeps playing while it's in your inventory and moves on to the next disc when one ends.
lore.spicedcider.bronze_movement: A small bronze clockwork movement with a pinned music drum. A crafting component for clockwork and musical contraptions.
lore.minecraft.moss_block: A soft block of moss that covers lush caves. Bone Meal spreads it over nearby stone and dirt. Needs a hoe to harvest; broken any other way, it drops nothing.
lore.minecraft.moss_carpet: A thin layer of moss that grows over the floors of lush caves. Needs a hoe to harvest; broken any other way, it drops nothing.
lore.minecraft.pale_moss_block: A grey, ashen moss. Bone Meal spreads it over nearby stone and dirt. Needs a hoe to harvest; broken any other way, it drops nothing.
lore.minecraft.pale_moss_carpet: A thin layer of pale moss that creeps up neighbouring walls. Needs a hoe to harvest; broken any other way, it drops nothing.
lore.minecraft.sugar: A sweetener used in cooking, and for crafting cakes and pies.
lore.minecraft.music_disc_cat: A music disc for the Jukebox. Found in Dungeon chests.
lore.minecraft.music_disc_11: A music disc for the Jukebox. Sometimes found inside Ancient Pots in caves.
lore.minecraft.music_disc_13: A music disc for the Jukebox. Found in Skeleton Dungeons.
lore.minecraft.music_disc_blocks: A music disc for the Jukebox. Found in Zombie Dungeons.
lore.minecraft.music_disc_chirp: A music disc for the Jukebox. Found in Ruined Portals.
lore.minecraft.music_disc_far: A music disc for the Jukebox. Found in Jungle Temples and jungle ruins.
lore.minecraft.music_disc_mall: A music disc for the Jukebox. Found in the hidden chests of Abandoned Camps.
lore.minecraft.music_disc_mellohi: A music disc for the Jukebox. Found in Buried Treasure.
lore.minecraft.music_disc_stal: A music disc for the Jukebox. Found in Buried Bunkers.
lore.minecraft.music_disc_strad: A music disc for the Jukebox. Found in Igloos.
lore.minecraft.music_disc_wait: A music disc for the Jukebox. Found in the supply chests of Shipwrecks.
lore.minecraft.music_disc_ward: A music disc for the Jukebox. Found in Desert and Badlands Pyramids.
lore.minecraft.music_disc_otherside: A music disc for the Jukebox. Found in Ancient Cities.
lore.minecraft.music_disc_pigstep: A music disc for the Jukebox. Found in Bastions.
lore.minecraft.music_disc_bounce: A music disc for the Jukebox. Found in Mineshafts.
lore.minecraft.music_disc_relic: A music disc for the Jukebox. Brushed out of Suspicious Gravel and Sand in Trail Ruins.
lore.minecraft.music_disc_5: A music disc for the Jukebox. Pieced together from Disc Fragments found in Ancient Cities.
lore.minecraft.disc_fragment_5: One piece of a shattered music disc, found in Ancient Cities. Nine of them make Music Disc 5.
